fields.author: Ingrid Holm
fields.standfirst: Seven mornings on the dock, one coffee at a time.
fields.body:
Seven mornings on the dock, one coffee at a time.

On the lake

The water is still before eight, and the loons are louder than the road. Take the canoe out early and you will have the bay to yourself.

Back at the cabin

Light the stove, put the kettle on and let the day decide itself. There is no schedule here, and that is the point.

seo.description: Five cedar cabins, two farmhouse rooms and a bunkhouse on the quiet side of Okanagan Lake.

/privacy.title: Privacy
/privacy.content:
Fern Hollow keeps the name, email and dates you give us to run your stay and to answer you. We do not sell them or share them.

The booking frame

Booking runs through our booking partner, whose own policy covers what you enter there.

/terms.title: Terms
/terms.content: A booking is confirmed by our booking partner. The house rules and the cancellation policy on the Policies page are part of every stay.

/accessibility.title: Accessibility
/accessibility.content: Alder and the Lake room have step-free entrances. Write to us and we will tell you exactly what to expect.
